workarounds.symptom: Windows: native TUI fails to install Bun when a virus scanner locks bun.exe (WinError 32)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: verify downloaded Bun at its final cache path. Target files: nanobot/bun.py, tests/test_bun.py. A first source launch on Windows can fail if a scanner keeps the staged `bun.exe` open after its version probe: installation still needs to rename the file at that point. Move the checksum-verified executable atomically into the cache before running `bun --version`, and keep the install lock through validation. Remove an unrunnable download instead of returning it. The pinned version and system Bun reuse are unchanged. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot/pull/6791)

workarounds.symptom: WebUI drops a streamed answer after an attachment in the same turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(webui): show streamed replies after attachments. Target files: webui/src/hooks/useNanobotStream.ts, webui/src/lib/thread-event-projection.ts, webui/src/tests/thread-transcript.test.ts. An assistant can send a map and then explain where to start. The WebUI displayed the map and its caption but dropped the explanation, even on replay when the stored stream snapshot contained the full answer. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot/pull/6766)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] WebUI channel secret fields get overwritten with the WebUI access password by browser autofill
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(webui): prevent sign-in autofill in channel credentials. Target files: webui/src/components/settings/channels/CredentialForm.tsx, webui/src/tests/settings-channels.test.tsx. Chrome can treat a channel token or password field as a sign-in field and fill it with the saved WebUI password. Saving then replaces the channel credential; Telegram can fail on its next start. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot/pull/6733)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] A drafted message() notification disappears from the next conversation turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(session): preserve literal assistant replies in history. Target files: nanobot/session/manager.py, tests/agent/test_session_manager_history.py. A user asked for a `message(...)` notification draft as text. When they asked the assistant to repeat it, the draft was gone from the next model request: replay had mistaken the reply for a tool call and removed it. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot/pull/6717)

workarounds.symptom: Tool parameter validation silently skips $ref / anyOf / oneOf schemas and crashes on tuple-form items
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tools): validate arguments with jsonschema without coercion. Target files: nanobot/agent/tools/base.py, nanobot/agent/tools/cron.py, nanobot/agent/tools/exec_session.py. . This is an alternative implementation to #6486, building on the bug report and reproductions from @xiong-wei1. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot/pull/6648)
